# id | where | planted defect | refused by

1 | as_lab_offset | the offset to a label is measured from the next instruction, 4 bytes too short | hand case 139, property 66 at round 0

3 | as_num | the minus sign of a number is dropped | hand case 20, property 65 at round 3
4 | as_imm | every range check accepts one value past the top of the range | hand case 246, property 65 at round 22
5 | as_dir_word | pass 1 does not count .word, so every later label is 4 bytes short | hand case 347, property 66 at round 0
6 | as_store | a store takes rs1 and rs2 in each other's place | hand case 90, property 61 at round 0
7 | as_num | the digits after 0x are read in base 10 | hand case 107, property 66 at round 0
8 | as_pass | the text after # is assembled as one more line | hand case 215, property 69 at round 0
9 | as_label | a second definition of a label is accepted and the first stays in use | hand case 352, property 68 at round 0
10 | as_lab_offset | an undefined label reads as offset 0 of the image | hand case 280, property 67 at round 0

13 | as_f_addr | the register in brackets is taken for an offset and the address register is left x0 | hand case 378, property 66 at round 0
